q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a hospital bed?
title: Hospital bed carbon footprint per bed
short: Weigh the steel tubes and sheet, castors, motors or cranks and mattress per bed and multiply by supplier figures. Add cutting, welding, powder coating and assembly energy, then divide by beds built.

p: Report per bed by type, since a motorised ICU bed carries more parts than a manual ward bed.

example.title: Worked example: hospital bed unit per bed (one month)
lines: Plant total: 16,800 / 1,000 = 16.8 kg CO2 per bed
Add steel, actuators and mattress for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
